bundle.what_it_does: Bundles group several audio tools under one purchase.
what_to_compare: Check the included tools and license terms.
Compare the current price with the recorded sale range.
bundle.who_needs_it: Useful when several included tools fit an existing workflow.

compressor.what_it_does: Compression controls changes in signal level over time.
what_to_compare: Compare timing, detection, and gain control options.
Check the available formats and system requirements.
compressor.who_needs_it: Useful when a mix needs more consistent dynamics.

delay.what_it_does: Delay repeats audio after a chosen interval.
what_to_compare: Compare timing, feedback, and filtering controls.
Check synchronization and routing options.
delay.who_needs_it: Useful for rhythmic repeats or spatial effects.

drums.what_it_does: Drum tools provide percussion sounds or ways to shape them.
what_to_compare: Compare sound sources, sequencing, and output routing.
Check the formats and storage requirements.
drums.who_needs_it: Useful for producing or arranging percussion parts.

effects.what_it_does: Effects alter the tone, space, or movement of an audio signal.
what_to_compare: Compare signal flow and modulation controls.
Check the processing formats and system requirements.
effects.who_needs_it: Useful when a track needs a specific sound treatment.

eq.what_it_does: Equalization changes the balance of frequency ranges.
what_to_compare: Compare filter types and analysis displays.
Check processing modes and supported formats.
eq.who_needs_it: Useful for balancing tones within a mix.

instrument.what_it_does: Virtual instruments generate playable sounds from MIDI input.
what_to_compare: Compare sound sources, articulation controls, and library size.
Check system and storage requirements.
instrument.who_needs_it: Useful when a project needs sounds that can be performed or sequenced.

limiter.what_it_does: Limiting reduces peaks above a chosen level.
what_to_compare: Compare ceiling, release, and metering controls.
Check supported processing modes.
limiter.who_needs_it: Useful when managing peaks in a mix or master.

mastering.what_it_does: Mastering tools help prepare a finished mix for delivery.
what_to_compare: Compare metering and processing controls.
Check export and format support.
mastering.who_needs_it: Useful during final level and tonal checks.

reverb.what_it_does: Reverb adds a sense of reflected sound and space.
what_to_compare: Compare decay, predelay, and tone controls.
Check routing and supported formats.
reverb.who_needs_it: Useful when placing sounds in a shared acoustic space.

saturation.what_it_does: Saturation adds harmonic content through nonlinear processing.
what_to_compare: Compare drive, tone, and output controls.
Check oversampling and level matching options.
saturation.who_needs_it: Useful when a sound needs added harmonic texture.

synth.what_it_does: Synthesizers generate sounds through oscillators, samples, or related methods.
what_to_compare: Compare sound generation and modulation controls.
Check preset management and system requirements.
synth.who_needs_it: Useful for designing playable electronic sounds.

utility.what_it_does: Utility tools support measurement, routing, or signal cleanup.
what_to_compare: Compare the available measurements and controls.
Check format support and workflow fit.
utility.who_needs_it: Useful for routine production and troubleshooting tasks.

vocal.what_it_does: Vocal tools process recorded voice or sung performance.
what_to_compare: Compare pitch, timing, and tone controls.
Check processing modes and supported formats.
vocal.who_needs_it: Useful when editing or mixing voice recordings.
